preprocessing: Original numeric features -> StandardScaler fitted on real training rows -> capped SMOTE -> protected TomekLinks -> LDA
features: ["fixed acidity", "volatile acidity", "citric acid", "residual sugar", "chlorides", "free sulfur dioxide", "total sulfur dioxide", "density", "pH", "sulphates", "alcohol"]
decision_rule: Native class-probability argmax in quality order3,4,5,6,7,8; first class on an exact tie
cv_design: Outer Stratified 4-fold x10 repeats seed42; inner Stratified 3-fold seed1042+outer index
estimate_label: Development repeated nested CV estimate of inner sampler-selection procedure
final_recipe_rule: Within the already selected LDA/protected-Tomek method, average each of the six registered candidates' existing mean inner-3-fold Macro F1 over all 40 outer-training splits. Rank by that mean descending, then fewer mean additions, fewer mean removals, and registered order. Use no outer scores to choose profile/k; perform no new search. This fixed deployment recipe is not separately validated: reported nested CV evaluates per-fold inner sampler selection.
